mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hypervisor_resource( hypervisor_id, status, availability_zone, total_vcpu, total_memory_gb, total_disk_gb, total_gpu, resource_version, updated_at) VALUES (#{hypervisorId}, 'MAINTENANCE', #{capacity.availabilityZone}, #{capacity.totalVcpus}, #{capacity.totalMemoryGb}, #{capacity.totalDiskGb}, #{capacity.gpus}, #{version}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE availability_zone = IF(resource_version < VALUES(resource_version), VALUES(availability_zone), availability_zone), total_vcpu = IF(resource_version < VALUES(resource_version), VALUES(total_vcpu), total_vcpu), total_memory_gb = IF(resource_version < VALUES(resource_version), VALUES(total_memory_gb), total_memory_gb), total_disk_gb = IF(resource_version < VALUES(resource_version), VALUES(total_disk_gb), total_disk_gb), total_gpu = IF(resource_version < VALUES(resource_version), VALUES(total_gpu), total_gpu), updated_at = IF(resource_version < VALUES(resource_version), VALUES(updated_at), updated_at), resource_version = GREATEST(resource_version, VALUES(resource_version))
mapper.update: UPDATE hypervisor_resource SET reserved_vcpu = reserved_vcpu + #{resources.vcpus} * #{reservationMultiplier}, allocated_vcpu = allocated_vcpu + #{resources.vcpus} * #{allocationMultiplier}, reserved_memory_gb = reserved_memory_gb + #{resources.memoryGb} * #{reservationMultiplier}, allocated_memory_gb = allocated_memory_gb + #{resources.memoryGb} * #{allocationMultiplier}, reserved_disk_gb = reserved_disk_gb + #{resources.diskGb} * #{reservationMultiplier}, allocated_disk_gb = allocated_disk_gb + #{resources.diskGb} * #{allocationMultiplier}, reserved_gpu = reserved_gpu + #{resources.gpuRequest} * #{reservationMultiplier}, allocated_gpu = allocated_gpu + #{resources.gpuRequest} * #{allocationMultiplier}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, resource_version = #{version}
UPDATE hypervisor_resource SET status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, resource_version = #{version}
UPDATE hypervisor_host SET hypervisor_status = #{status}, expected_maintenance_time = COALESCE(#{expectedMaintenanceTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, expected_maintenance_time) WHERE id = #{hypervisorId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO instance_allocation( instance_id, hypervisor_id, reservation_id, vcpus, memory_gb, disk_gb, gpu_count, allocation_status, resource_version, updated_at) VALUES (#{allocation.instanceId}, #{hypervisorId}, #{allocation.reservationId}, #{allocation.resources.vcpus}, #{allocation.resources.memoryGb}, #{allocation.resources.diskGb}, #{allocation.resources.gpuRequest}, #{status}, #{version}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE hypervisor_id = IF(resource_version < VALUES(resource_version), VALUES(hypervisor_id), hypervisor_id), reservation_id = IF(resource_version < VALUES(resource_version), VALUES(reservation_id), reservation_id), vcpus = IF(resource_version < VALUES(resource_version), VALUES(vcpus), vcpus), memory_gb = IF(resource_version < VALUES(resource_version), VALUES(memory_gb), memory_gb), disk_gb = IF(resource_version < VALUES(resource_version), VALUES(disk_gb), disk_gb), gpu_count = IF(resource_version < VALUES(resource_version), VALUES(gpu_count), gpu_count), allocation_status = IF(resource_version < VALUES(resource_version), VALUES(allocation_status), allocation_status), updated_at = IF(resource_version < VALUES(resource_version), VALUES(updated_at), updated_at), resource_version = GREATEST(resource_version, VALUES(resource_version))
